description.value: Togo Sushi is a BC-based sushi chain specialising in fresh, made-to-order rolls and bowls available for takeout or quick on-site dining. The Tsawwassen location sits inside Tsawwassen Mills shopping centre, a large destination mall near the BC Ferries terminal and the US border crossing. Cyclists passing through the Tsawwassen peninsula will find it a convenient stop for a fast, filling meal.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (12 spaces) at 94m; rack at 95m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Togo Sushi is a real, operating multi-location sushi chain with a Tsawwassen Mills food court location ('652-5000 0B3, Canoe Pass Way, Tsawwassen'). No bike parking, washroom, Wi-Fi, or other amenity details appear anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
